newsitem.title: USA: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.
newsitem.headline: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.

text.p: USDA said the 23.973 million bushels wheat and 35.153 million bushels of corn inspected in the week to Oct 24 included the following destinations (1,000 bu):
WHEAT: Lakes to Algeria 728; Morocco 608; Turkey 628; Venezuela 491.
Gulf to Colombia 1,015; Egypt 3,709; Ethiopia 65; Georgia 1,572; Grenada 133; Italy 367; Lebanon 398; Mexico 733; Mozambique 257; Nigeria 1,209; Panama 262; Peru 878; South Africa 961; Venezuela 364.
WHEAT: Pacific to Japan 3,245; South Korea 1,168; Pakistan 1,670; Philippines 1,259.

Gulf to Angola 168; Chile 811; Taiwan 2,155; Colombia 682; Costa Rica 882; Grenada 55; Guatamela 12; Japan 9,323; South Korea 2,170; Mexico 2,841; Morocco 906; Panama 461; Peru 261; Saudi Arabia 2,622; Suriname 108.
